item.name: Write and verify episode watch progress

exec: const send = (method, url, token, body) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => pm.sendRequest({ url, method, header: Object.assign({ 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, token ? { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token } : {}), body: body === undefined ? undefined : { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify(body) } }, (error, response) => error ? reject(error) : resolve(response)));

const base = pm.variables.replaceIn('{{baseUrl}}'); const freeEpisode = pm.collectionVariables.get('freeEpisodeId'); const dramaUrl = base + '/dramas/' + pm.collectionVariables.get('dramaId'); const unentitled = pm.collectionVariables.get('unentitledAccessToken'); const entitled = pm.collectionVariables.get('entitledAccessToken'); const progressUrl = episode => base + '/me/episodes/' + episode + '/watch-progress';

const freePlayback = await send('GET', base + '/episodes/' + freeEpisode + '/playback', unentitled); pm.test('Free episode playback provides the server duration', () => { pm.expect(freePlayback.code).to.equal(200); pm.expect(freePlayback.json().durationMs).to.be.above(0); }); const freeDuration = freePlayback.json().durationMs; const threshold = Math.ceil((freeDuration * 2) / 3);

const startedAt = Date.now(); const started = await send('PUT', progressUrl(freeEpisode) + '?userUuid=' + pm.variables.get('entitledUserUuid'), unentitled, { event: 'STARTED', positionMs: 0, userUuid: pm.variables.get('entitledUserUuid') }); pm.test('STARTED uses the JWT user and returns 204', () => pm.expect(started.code).to.equal(204));

const detail = await send('GET', dramaUrl, unentitled); const startedVerifiedAt = Date.now(); pm.test('STARTED inserts zero incomplete progress with a UTC timestamp from this request', () => { pm.expect(detail.code).to.equal(200); const episode = detail.json().episodes.find(item => item.uuid === freeEpisode); pm.expect(episode.watchProgress.positionMs).to.equal(0); pm.expect(episode.watchProgress.isCompleted).to.equal(false); const lastPlayedAt = Date.parse(episode.watchProgress.lastPlayedAt); pm.expect(lastPlayedAt).to.be.at.least(startedAt - 5000); pm.expect(lastPlayedAt).to.be.at.most(startedVerifiedAt + 5000); });

const repeatStart = await send('PUT', progressUrl(freeEpisode), unentitled, { event: 'STARTED', positionMs: 0 }); pm.test('Repeated STARTED remains successful', () => pm.expect(repeatStart.code).to.equal(204));

const invalidInputs = [{ event: 'OTHER', positionMs: 0 }, { event: 'STARTED', positionMs: -1 }, { event: 'STARTED', positionMs: 0.5 }, { event: 'STARTED', positionMs: 1 }, { event: 'COMPLETED', positionMs: threshold - 1 }, { event: 'COMPLETED', positionMs: freeDuration + 1 }, null];

for (const body of invalidInputs) { const response = await send('PUT', progressUrl(freeEpisode), unentitled, body); pm.test('Invalid watch-progress input returns 400', () => pm.expect(response.code).to.equal(400)); }

const anonymous = await send('PUT', progressUrl(freeEpisode), null, { event: 'STARTED', positionMs: 0 }); pm.test('Watch progress requires authentication', () => { pm.expect(anonymous.code).to.equal(401); pm.expect(anonymous.json().errorCode).to.equal('AUTH_INVALID_TOKEN'); }); const invalidToken = await send('PUT', progressUrl(freeEpisode), 'invalid-token', { event: 'STARTED', positionMs: 0 }); pm.test('Invalid Access JWT returns the existing 401 error', () => { pm.expect(invalidToken.code).to.equal(401); pm.expect(invalidToken.json().errorCode).to.equal('AUTH_INVALID_TOKEN'); });

const missing = await send('PUT', progressUrl(pm.collectionVariables.get('missingId')), unentitled, { event: 'STARTED', positionMs: 0 }); pm.test('Missing episode returns 404', () => pm.expect(missing.code).to.equal(404));

const denied = await send('PUT', progressUrl(pm.variables.get('lockedEpisodeUuid')), unentitled, { event: 'STARTED', positionMs: 0 }); pm.test('Unpurchased paid episode returns the existing 403 error', () => { pm.expect(denied.code).to.equal(403); pm.expect(denied.json().errorCode).to.equal('EPISODE_ACCESS_DENIED'); });

const completedAt = Date.now(); const complete = await send('PUT', progressUrl(freeEpisode), unentitled, { event: 'COMPLETED', positionMs: threshold }); pm.test('Two-thirds boundary saves completion', () => pm.expect(complete.code).to.equal(204)); const completedDetail = await send('GET', dramaUrl, unentitled); const completedVerifiedAt = Date.now(); pm.test('COMPLETED update returns a UTC timestamp from this request', () => { pm.expect(completedDetail.code).to.equal(200); const episode = completedDetail.json().episodes.find(item => item.uuid === freeEpisode); const lastPlayedAt = Date.parse(episode.watchProgress.lastPlayedAt); pm.expect(lastPlayedAt).to.be.at.least(completedAt - 5000); pm.expect(lastPlayedAt).to.be.at.most(completedVerifiedAt + 5000); });

const laterStart = await send('PUT', progressUrl(freeEpisode), unentitled, { event: 'STARTED', positionMs: 0 }); pm.test('Later STARTED cannot clear completion', () => pm.expect(laterStart.code).to.equal(204));

const concurrent = await Promise.all([send('PUT', progressUrl(freeEpisode), unentitled, { event: 'STARTED', positionMs: 0 }), send('PUT', progressUrl(freeEpisode), unentitled, { event: 'COMPLETED', positionMs: threshold })]); pm.test('Concurrent start and completion both succeed', () => concurrent.forEach(response => pm.expect(response.code).to.equal(204)));

const finalDetail = await send('GET', dramaUrl, unentitled); pm.test('Completion position is retained and another user and anonymous see null', async () => { const episode = finalDetail.json().episodes.find(item => item.uuid === freeEpisode); pm.expect(episode.watchProgress.isCompleted).to.equal(true); pm.expect(episode.watchProgress.positionMs).to.equal(threshold); const other = await send('GET', dramaUrl, entitled); pm.expect(other.json().episodes.find(item => item.uuid === freeEpisode).watchProgress).to.equal(null); const publicDetail = await send('GET', dramaUrl); pm.expect(publicDetail.json().episodes.find(item => item.uuid === freeEpisode).watchProgress).to.equal(null); });

const paidStart = await send('PUT', progressUrl(pm.variables.get('entitledEpisodeUuid')), entitled, { event: 'STARTED', positionMs: 0 }); pm.test('Purchased paid episode accepts progress', () => pm.expect(paidStart.code).to.equal(204));
})().catch(error => pm.test('Watch progress HTTP scenarios complete', () => { throw error; }));
